title: F01 Spring to FastAPI Internal Context Envelope
description: Minimal authorized context envelope constructed by Spring Boot and dispatched to the internal FastAPI AI service for F01 general knowledge inquiries.

requestId.description: Spring-owned AI Run ID; internal result runId must echo this identity.

requestType.description: Fixed feature identifier for general fitness knowledge.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID for distributed tracing across Spring, FastAPI, and audit logs.

userId.description: Authenticated user identity requesting the inquiry.

role.description: Server-selected active capability, not a role name supplied by the client. Admin alone does not grant F01 access.

purpose.description: Fixed purpose code; prevents scope expansion or unauthorized mutation.

allowedActions.description: Whitelisted server-granted actions; F01 only permits READ_INFORMATION.

asOf.description: Timestamp at which context was constructed.

exerciseContext.description: Optional catalog-validated metadata if question is pinned to an active exercise.

status.description: RAG must strictly retrieve only ACTIVE knowledge versions.

allowedSourceIds.description: Whitelisted sources in scope (e.g. ISSN-PROTEIN-EXERCISE-2017, WHO-PA-SB-2020).

knowledgeScope.description: Server-owned scope. Empty source set returns NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE; never broaden to DRAFT or another scope.
